run_create_low_shot_samples: run the CLI to generate low-shot training samples for VOC or Places datasets
generate_voc07_low_shot_samples: generate VOC07 low-shot target matrices with k positives and (num_classes-1)*k negatives per sample
generate_places_low_shot_samples: generate Places low-shot image and label files with k samples per class for SVM training
generate_low_shot_samples: generate low-shot samples for either VOC or Places datasets based on dataset_name argument
sample_places_data: sample k images per class from input images and targets returning sampled images and labels
